readme.run: Segment contrast-enhancing brain tumours and compute MNI RADS reports
notes: Both pinned Raidionics v1.3 ONNX models (MRI_Brain and MRI_TumorCore/t1c) and all
MNI ICBM152 2009a atlases, BCB white-matter tracts and resectability maps are included.
No network connection or previously populated cache is required.
Add --skull-stripped for skull-stripped T1c inputs, --no-mni for native morphometry only,
--mask PATH to characterize an existing binary tumour mask, or --help for all options.
DICOM import and interactive 3D slice inspection use the web app.
Research software only; not for clinical diagnosis or surgical planning.
Please cite Bouget et al. (Raidionics v1.3 / RADS) and Kommers et al. (2021) for GBM resectability.
